line_sha_binding_scope: Each line SHA is copied from the immutable reconciliation index; the final whole-witness analyzer independently verifies actual gzip line bytes.
interpretation: Every case has a nonzero exact rational objective difference. Fifteen actual expanded paths have identical sequential IEEE-754 double sums; one has a one-ULP larger CH sum. Both legal alternatives retain different actual time/distance. Existing CH uses float preparation costs and quantized shortcut weights; the branch float32 sums reverse ranking. The particular historical witness/shortcut omission causing selection has not been replayed or proven.
sequential_sum_scope: Weights are recomputed from captured selected edge/turn terms using the original Dijkstra transition-plus-current accumulation order. The original witness did not separately serialize Path.getWeight() for plain Dijkstra.

original_failure: IllegalStateException: selected CH actual objective differs from independent pair Dijkstra exact edge/turn sum
